component.name: PortGlance
component.summary: See which dev servers are listening, at a glance

description.p: PortGlance keeps an eye on the ports your dev servers listen on. A top-panel indicator shows how many are running; click it for the list.

ul.li: See the port, protocol, process, PID, uptime and memory of every listener
Know which project each server belongs to: its git repository and branch
Docker and Podman containers with their published ports and Compose projects
Stop a server in one click: SIGTERM first, SIGKILL if it does not exit
Open any HTTP port in the browser
System services stay out of the way unless you ask for them
Pin the ports you care about and a compact desktop widget

description.p: PortGlance reads the kernel's socket tables directly and only does the expensive work when a new listener appears, so it stays light.

screenshot.caption: The top-panel indicator and its menu
